description: This file is a unit test class for the EmailService component within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It contains various test cases to verify the behavior of email configuration and email sending functionalities, including mocking external dependencies and configurations.

classes.name: EmailServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the EmailService functionalities in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the EmailConfigurationService before each test.

methods.description: Tests that the EmailConfigurationDao returned by the service instance is of the correct type.

methods.name: testSendTestMail
methods.description: Mocks the sendTestEmail method to verify it is called properly and returns true.
